description.value:
You coalesce junk together to make an improvised explosive device. You create a commercial grade grenade in your hand, the hand of an adjacent ally, or on the ground in adjacent square. Choose the type of grenade when you Cast the Spell, using the following list: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Electromag Grenade (Commercial)]{electromagnetic grenade}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Flash Grenade (Commercial)]{flash grenade}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Frag Grenade (Commercial)]{frag grenade}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Glitterbomb (Commercial)]{glitterbomb}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Incendiary Grenade (Commercial)]{incendiary grenade}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Smoke Grenade (Commercial)]{smoke grenade}. The Reflex save for this grenade uses your spell DC instead of your class DC.

Heightened (2nd) You can create a tactical grenade.

Heightened (4th) You can create an advanced grenade.

Heightened (5th) You can create a superior grenade.

Heightened (6th) You can create an elite grenade.

Heightened (8th) You can create an ultimate grenade.

Heightened (9th) You can create a paragon grenade.
